record.name: Doctor
record.description: Doctors are practitioners of the medical arts, capable of stabilizing the gravely wounded, enhancing recovery, and keeping allies in peak condition under fire.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: A compassionate practitioner of the medical arts

progression_tree.description: You gain proficiency in Medicine and can add your proficiency bonus to any Medicine check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

effects.notes: The Medical Savant's training allows them to instinctively diagnose and treat injuries, granting a +2 bonus to Medicine checks.

progression_tree.description: You can use your bonus action to touch a creature and stabilize it, ending the bleeding.

effects.notes: The Doctor's hands weave a subtle pattern, siphoning the wound's chaotic energy and stabilizing its flow.

progression_tree.description: You gain expertise in Medicine and can add your proficiency bonus to any Medicine check you make.

effects.notes: The Doctor instinctively assesses the damage, and their trained hands apply a precise touch to mitigate the wound. They gain +1d6 bonus healing when treating wounds.

progression_tree.description: When a creature you are treating with Medicine is reduced to 0 hit points, they can use their reaction to make a Constitution saving throw against your DC. If successful, the creature is stabilized.

effects.notes: With a swift and practiced hand, you quickly assess the critical wound. You administer an injection of stabilizing serum, halting further blood loss and preventing shock.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Standing with feet shoulder-width apart, left foot slightly forward and weight evenly distributed between both feet.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A soft blue glow emanating from the character's hands and surrounding their body.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A compassionate Doctor standing in a peaceful forest, surrounded by lush greenery and towering trees.
